Video.title: Exercise Is the Medicine Nobody Prescribes
caption: When everything falls apart, your head gets loud. Regret. Shame. What-ifs.
Sweat is quieter. Exercise won't fix your problems, but it gives you the clarity to fix them yourself. Don't wait to feel like it. Lace up anyway. 30 minutes, every day.
Comment what you're doing today: walk, run, or lift.
